character: Vibrant village with its own ski area — Grands Montets glacier (3,275m). Traditional Savoyard village, popular with experts. Superb off-piste. Train station. Good shops, restaurants, bars.
dining: Le Grenier (local organic). Aux Dix Vins (burgers, great apres). Argentero (piste-side, large terrace, Grands Montets). Plan Joran (ski-access).
shopping: Supermarket, bakery, sports rental, bars. Train station.
apres_scene: Aux Dix Vins (burger apres). Argentero terrace. Grands Montets base bar.
activities_nearby: Grands Montets ski area (glacier to 3,275m). Off-piste to Le Tour. Train to Chamonix (10 min).
